caption: The drawing is divided into three rectangular panels, with one large rectangle at the top and two smaller rectangles beneath it, separated by a horizontal and a vertical line. The images are rendered in a monochromatic color scheme, featuring white line drawings on a dark, textured background. The objects depicted include numerous abstract and geometric figures resembling animals, humans, spirals, circular forms with radiating lines, and various angular shapes. In the top rectangle, there are multiple animal-like and human-like forms arranged in a seemingly random arrangement, intermingled with circular and sunburst patterns, as well as a few shapes resembling tools or objects. The lower left rectangle contains a large, branching, maze-like geometric figure with smaller circular and spiked shapes attached to it. The bottom right rectangle features more animal and human-like figures, another circular sun-like shape surrounded by additional animals, and a stepped, angular shape that looks like a stylized structure. Throughout the composition, the white figures contrast distinctly with the stippled dark background, making the individual shapes clear and separate.
title: Petroglyph
